method: Three independent Node processes; actual full _preparePointCloud; fresh processor per operation; 10 warmups per arm/cohort; 30 alternating AB/BA pairs; counting separate from timing.
source_window: Measured pre-edit source plus one-expression in-memory candidate. Final actual source exactly reconstructs that candidate; final contracts only, no paired-timing rerun.

final_contracts.source_window: Final production candidate; baseline reconstructed by reversing exactly one measurement expression
final_contracts.scope: Full synchronous _preparePointCloud with new processor per call, excluding worker serialization, viewer admission, GPU, network and browser

existing_regression_results.note: Scopes overlap; do not sum into whole-frontend coverage. Page-store suite emits incidental timings, not matched A/B findings.
